title: easy shulker
description: Adds a shulker box that has 9 slots instead of the normal 27.
body:
With this plugin you can create a Small Shulker Box that has 9 slots. You do not need to go to then End to get the materials for it. It's an early game sort of thing, so you can have gear on you at all time! If there are any bugs join the discord server and ping @stickyballs2652

![recipe for small shulker box](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2bcc3fc75d940e2849d1a054a284ee9cf45f5f33.png)
